policy_assessment: The unfiltered all-cache policy can remove roots protected by keepDuration in an earlier policy.
The pinned engine greedily cuts persisted roots and releases their transitive dependencies, so reclaimed bytes can exceed the requested amount.
A separate Dagger limit avoids also increasing the Bazel cache limit.
Free-space targets remain active; they are collection targets, not a filesystem reservation or a hard upper bound on active builds.
